package domain

import (
	"github.com/google/uuid"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

func TestHybridEvidenceQualityUsesOnlyFrozenProvenance(t *testing.T) {
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name                   string
		source, class, surface string
		expected               HybridEvidenceQuality
	}{
		{"quiz", "course_answer", "knowledge_check", "", HybridQualityAssessment},
		{"execution", "course_answer", "application", "", HybridQualityExecution},
		{"practice", "practice_v2", "application", "practice", HybridQualityExecution},
		{"project", "practice_v2", "application", "project", HybridQualityProject},
		{"legacy", "practice_legacy", "application", "", HybridQualityExecution},
		{"unknown surface", "practice_v2", "application", "", HybridQualityUnknown},
		{"unknown provenance", "unknown", "application", "project", HybridQualityUnknown},
		{"teacher assistance", "teacher_assistance", "application", "", HybridQualityUnknown},
		{"unrecognized class", "course_answer", "unknown", "", HybridQualityUnknown},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			e := HybridEvidenceReference{SourceKind: tc.source, EvidenceClass: tc.class, SurfaceClassification: tc.surface}
			if got := ClassifyHybridEvidence(e); got != tc.expected {
				t.Fatalf("quality=%s want=%s", got, tc.expected)
			}
		})
	}
	if DefaultMasteryConfidence != .80 {
		t.Fatal("accepted existing threshold changed")
	}
}

func TestHybridStabilityUsesIndependentApplicationsAndDistinctReducerTasks(t *testing.T) {
	target := HybridTargetRef{Type: TargetConcept, Key: "go.syntax", Version: "v1"}
	e := func(id, task string) HybridEvidenceReference {
		eid := uuid.NewSHA1(uuid.NameSpaceOID, []byte(id)).String()
		tid := uuid.NewSHA1(uuid.NameSpaceOID, []byte(task)).String()
		return HybridEvidenceReference{Target: target, SourceKind: "course_answer", EvidenceID: eid, LearningActionID: eid, TaskID: tid, EvidenceClass: "application", Outcome: "passed", SupportContext: "independent", Kind: "independent_application", TeacherPolicyVersion: "teacher-support-v1", MasteryPolicyVersion: StudentMasteryPolicyVersion, OccurredAt: time.Date(2026, 10, 5, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)}
	}
	a, b, c := e("1", "task-a"), e("2", "task-b"), e("3", "task-b")
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name            string
		state           MasteryState
		evidence        []HybridEvidenceReference
		expected        HybridMasteryStability
		count, distinct int
	}{
		{"one application", MasteryMastered, []HybridEvidenceReference{a}, HybridStabilityUnstable, 1, 1},
		{"two same task", MasteryMastered, []HybridEvidenceReference{a, e("2", "task-a")}, HybridStabilityUnstable, 2, 1},
		{"two distinct", MasteryMastered, []HybridEvidenceReference{a, b}, HybridStabilityDeveloping, 2, 2},
		{"three not mastered", MasteryApplied, []HybridEvidenceReference{a, b, c}, HybridStabilityDeveloping, 3, 2},
		{"three mastered", MasteryMastered, []HybridEvidenceReference{a, b, c}, HybridStabilityStable, 3, 2},
		{"duplicate evidence", MasteryMastered, []HybridEvidenceReference{a, b, b}, HybridStabilityDeveloping, 2, 2},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			m := HybridSnapshotMastery{Target: target, State: tc.state, IndependentSuccessCount: 999}
			got := DeriveHybridTargetSignal(m, tc.evidence)
			if got.Stability != tc.expected || got.IndependentApplications != tc.count || got.DistinctApplicationSources != tc.distinct {
				t.Fatalf("signal=%+v", got)
			}
		})
	}
	quiz := a
	quiz.EvidenceClass = "knowledge_check"
	quiz.Kind = "independent_understanding"
	assisted := b
	assisted.SupportContext = "guided"
	assisted.Kind = "assisted_application"
	failed := c
	failed.Outcome = "failed"
	failed.Kind = "failed_application"
	signal := DeriveHybridTargetSignal(HybridSnapshotMastery{Target: target, State: MasteryMastered, IndependentSuccessCount: 999}, []HybridEvidenceReference{quiz, assisted, failed})
	if signal.IndependentApplications != 0 || signal.Stability != HybridStabilityUnstable {
		t.Fatalf("non-independent inputs fabricated stability: %+v", signal)
	}
	practice := []HybridEvidenceReference{a, b, c}
	for i := range practice {
		practice[i].SourceKind = "practice_v2"
		practice[i].SurfaceClassification = "practice"
		practice[i].TaskInstanceID = practice[i].TaskID
		practice[i].TaskID = ""
		practice[i].TaskRevisionID = uuid.NewSHA1(uuid.NameSpaceOID, []byte("same-revision")).String()
		practice[i].SubmissionID = practice[i].EvidenceID
		practice[i].ReceiptHash = "sha256:" + strings.Repeat("a", 64)
	}
	if got := DeriveHybridTargetSignal(HybridSnapshotMastery{Target: target, State: MasteryMastered}, practice); got.Stability != HybridStabilityStable || got.DistinctApplicationSources != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("wrong Practice reducer identity: %+v", got)
	}
	malformed := append([]HybridEvidenceReference{}, practice...)
	level := 1
	malformed[0].MaxHintLevel = &level
	if got := DeriveHybridTargetSignal(HybridSnapshotMastery{Target: target, State: MasteryMastered}, malformed); got.Stability == HybridStabilityStable || got.IndependentApplications != 2 || got.Quality != HybridQualityUnknown {
		t.Fatalf("malformed hints counted as independent stability: %+v", got)
	}
	unclassified := append([]HybridEvidenceReference{}, practice...)
	for i := range unclassified {
		unclassified[i].SurfaceClassification = ""
	}
	if got := DeriveHybridTargetSignal(HybridSnapshotMastery{Target: target, State: MasteryMastered}, unclassified); got.Stability != HybridStabilityStable || got.Quality != HybridQualityUnknown {
		t.Fatalf("valid Student independence was redefined by unknown quality: %+v", got)
	}
	unknown := a
	unknown.SourceKind = "unknown"
	if got := DeriveHybridTargetSignal(HybridSnapshotMastery{Target: target, State: MasteryMastered}, append(practice, unknown)); got.Quality != HybridQualityUnknown {
		t.Fatalf("mixed unknown provenance bypassed quality: %+v", got)
	}
}

func TestHybridObservationRequiresRealTargetBoundTheoryFact(t *testing.T) {
	target := HybridTargetRef{Type: TargetConcept, Key: "go.syntax", Version: "v1"}
	m := HybridSnapshotMastery{Target: target, State: MasteryUnknown}
	s := HybridPlanningSnapshot{Path: HybridSnapshotPath{Items: []HybridSnapshotItem{{ID: "item", Targets: []HybridTargetRef{target}}}}, ActivityFacts: []HybridSnapshotActivityFact{{ItemID: "item", Type: "theory_acknowledged"}}}
	if got := DeriveHybridSnapshotTargetSignal(s, m); got.Quality != HybridQualityObservation || got.Stability != HybridStabilityUnstable {
		t.Fatalf("signal=%+v", got)
	}
	s.ActivityFacts[0].Type = "teacher_hint"
	if got := DeriveHybridSnapshotTargetSignal(s, m); got.Quality != HybridQualityUnknown {
		t.Fatalf("hint inferred objective observation: %+v", got)
	}
}

func TestHybridUnknownEvidenceCannotFallbackToObservation(t *testing.T) {
	target := HybridTargetRef{Type: TargetConcept, Key: "go.syntax", Version: "v1"}
	m := HybridSnapshotMastery{Target: target, State: MasteryMastered}
	s := HybridPlanningSnapshot{Path: HybridSnapshotPath{Items: []HybridSnapshotItem{{ID: "item", Targets: []HybridTargetRef{target}}}}, ActivityFacts: []HybridSnapshotActivityFact{{ItemID: "item", Type: "theory_acknowledged"}}, Evidence: []HybridEvidenceReference{{Target: target, SourceKind: "practice_v2", EvidenceClass: "application"}}}
	if got := DeriveHybridSnapshotTargetSignal(s, m); got.Quality != HybridQualityUnknown {
		t.Fatalf("unknown objective provenance became %s", got.Quality)
	}
}
